design_vibe: Warm, Cozy Coffee-House with Swiss Editorial Aesthetics
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with EDITORIAL PRECISION

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#2C221E] font-serif
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#2C221E] font-serif
rules.caption_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] font-mono text-[#C86D3B] font-semibold

navigation.header_style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF6F0]/90 border-b border-[#E4DACF] transition-all duration-200
navigation.mobile_menu: Sheet component with warm paper background, rich typography and quick login/register links

layout_patterns.landing_hero: Asymmetrical two-column grid (md:grid-cols-12 gap-8) with bold headline, quick feature tags ('Quiet for work', 'Artisanal Roaster', 'Pet-Friendly', 'Matcha & Pastries'), quick search input bar with price filter chips, and floating interactive photo hero frame
layout_patterns.explore_grid: Sidebar layout (Filter drawer on mobile, 3-col filter sidebar on desktop) with Tetris bento grid for cafes featuring hero spotlight card, standard cafe cards, and high-density stats widget
layout_patterns.detail_page: Multi-section layout featuring 4-photo asymmetrical mosaic hero gallery, key stats strip (Rating, Price level, Wifi speed, Vibe score, Noise level), interactive tabs for Menu, Reviews + AI Summary, Photos, and Location Info, plus floating sticky review writer button
layout_patterns.ai_barista_chat: Floating bottom-right drawer / side panel with coffee cup trigger button, quick prompt suggestions ('Find cozy cafes with outlet access near me', 'Best cold brew and vegan muffins', 'Romantic evening cafe with wine and desserts'), and structured recommendation response cards

cafe_card.container: bg-white border border-[#E4DACF] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:border-[#C86D3B]/50 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-1 group relative
cafe_card.price_badge: absolute top-3 right-3 bg-[#2C221E]/80 backdrop-blur-sm text-[#FAF6F0] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-semibold
cafe_card.rating_pill: absolute bottom-3 left-3 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm text-[#2C221E] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm

menu_section.item_row: flex items-start justify-between p-4 bg-[#FAF6F0]/60 hover:bg-[#FAF6F0] rounded-xl border border-[#E4DACF]/60 transition-colors duration-200

ai_summary_box.container: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F3EBE1] to-[#FAF6F0] border border-[#C86D3B]/30 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm
ai_summary_box.badge: inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#C86D3B]/10 text-[#C86D3B] text-xs font-mono font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full mb-3

testing_and_data_ids.rule: Every interactive button, link, search input, filter tab, star rating, modal trigger, and chat action MUST have data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app uses React + Tailwind CSS with the warm coffee house color palette specified in design_guidelines.json.
Import Google Fonts for Playfair Display, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono in index.html / index.css.

Support full feature set: Home search, Explore with comprehensive filters & sorting, Cafe Details (Menu, Reviews, AI Summary, Photo gallery, Rating breakdown), AI Barista Chat drawer, Saved/Favorite Cafes with local/backend persistence, JWT Login/Register, and Admin Panel for managing cafes & menus.
Implement realistic seeded mock data in FastAPI backend (MongoDB) if DB is empty so the user immediately sees 8+ rich cafes with menus, photos, wifi status, noise level, and reviews.
Use sonner for toast notifications when saving cafes, submitting reviews, or logging in.
Ensure all components are modular JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files in /app/frontend/src.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, search inputs, and form controls.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not build generic white/dark blue dashboards. Use warm paper tones (#FAF6F0), rich roasted amber buttons (#C86D3B), and elegant serif headlines (Playfair Display).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) and clear spatial hierarchy. Never crowd elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Add smooth explicit transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, hover:-translate-y-1). Avoid transition-all on wrapper grids.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.placeholders: NEVER use placeholder.com URLs. ALWAYS use the curated Unsplash image URLs provided in design_guidelines.json.
